input.description: Telemetry shows oil pressure declining steadily and monotonically from 35.7 psi to ~18 psi over ~70 minutes, then plateauing near 18-19 psi, while coolant temp (~88-90°C) and RPM (~1600-1700) stayed stable — this pattern looks like a genuine mechanical oil pressure loss (e.g., pump wear, leak, or filter restriction), not sensor noise. Only one relevant KB entry exists (KB-004: 'low oil pressure warning, not resolved by sensor restart,' fix = schedule_service_visit), so there is no documented disagreement to reconcile, but it also rules out restart_sensor as effective, and no KB entry supports send_diagnostic_reset for this symptom. Since the one documented remote-capable option (restart_sensor) is explicitly contraindicated by KB-004 and the only validated fix (schedule_service_visit) was already rejected due to bay scheduling, there is no safe whitelisted remote fix supported by evidence. Recommend human review to arrange an expedited/out-of-network service slot or interim operating restrictions (e.g., load/RPM limits) rather than a remote sensor action, given the risk of true low oil pressure causing engine damage.
